Phase-5 supplemental dead/deprecated-code census completed at audited snapshot 9a94ef9737fb. An independent read-only pass plus root semantic/raw-reference and Git-history checks found eight material removals in four candidate scopes:

1. SDC1: unreachable reconciler rebase_retry/Result/RescheduleError residue. Preserve live ReconcileLockLost -> RESCHEDULE behavior, direct legacy exit translation while applicable, and store RebaseGuard exit 75. HARDENING, validity 0.80 / impact 0.75.
2. SDC2: retired LLM pass4_coach and v1 executor _guard_passes helpers. Migrate assertions to live workflow/shared-kernel paths before deletion. Validity 1.00; impacts 0.67/0.59.
3. SDC3: extend the already-approved internal-shim census with failure_usage -> run_shape, two _is_transient_add_error aliases -> gitutil canonical owner, and two _referencing_commit_exists wrappers -> _referencing_commits/behavioral close coverage. Four smaller test-only shims were also enumerated as census inputs, not standalone work.
4. SDC4: remove dead Jira _fit_description and wrong-envelope _direct_rest_put after retaining OutboundFieldMapper fit ordering and _direct_rest_put_raw behavior. Impacts 0.59 each.

Excluded: dead _env_truthy and _VERIFIER_DEFAULT_MODEL fall below the Janitor impact floor; outbound_differ._rest_issue_to_snapshot_fields is an intentional parity-test seam and is not safe for bare deletion until live fetcher/mapper parity coverage replaces it.

Full citations, history, reachability controls, and scan commands are recorded in .joe-janitor/report-2026-08-29.md and .joe-janitor/tools.md. No product code was edited. The four supplemental scopes now return to one-item approval before ticket creation.
